verdict.rationale: vLLM documents a CLI command that starts its OpenAI-compatible API server (`vllm serve`), plus an official Docker image for running that server. It supports 200+ HF architectures and a Transformers backend, so most loaded models can be served, and a community user confirms preferring and using the OpenAI-compatible API. missing for 10: a documented list of the specific OpenAI endpoints served and a hands-on launch walkthrough confirming arbitrary-model serving.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on HuggingFace
Cool, I prefer the OpenAI-Compatible api.
